description: List types provide different default feature sets that offer varied levels of functionality. Choose a type that provides your end users with the list capabilities they need.
label: Type
name: listType

choices.label: Default
choices.sublabel: A list with a full feature set

choices.label: Simple
choices.sublabel: A simplified list for small spaces within dashboards etc

description: Select how to display data. List layout presents data in rows and columns. Gallery layout displays data in a card-based format. If you choose multiple layouts, users will be able to switch between them.
label: Layouts
name: layouts

choices.label: List only
choices.sublabel: Present data in rows and columns

choices.label: Gallery only
choices.sublabel: Display data in a card-based format

choices.label: Both list and gallery
choices.sublabel: Allow users to switch between layouts

description: Choose an initial layout to display the data.
label: Displayed layout
name: displayedLayout

choices.label: List
choices.sublabel: Present data in rows and columns

choices.label: Gallery
choices.sublabel: Display data in a card-based format

description: Select the table data to display in the list.
label: Table
name: table

description: If you don't want to use the default list title, you may configure your own.
label: List title
name: listTitle

description: Users can't change the fixed filter.
label: Fixed filter
name: fixedFilter

description: Users can change the default filter.
label: Default filter
name: filter

description: Group records by a data field. For example, you can group a list of employees by office location.
label: Group by
name: groupBy

description: Predefined column selection and order, as set in the [sys_ui_view] table.
label: View
name: view

description: Nest parent and child records by specifying fields. For example, you can have multiple products nested under each product bundle.
label: Nest by
name: nestBy

description: Set how many child records to fetch at once before displaying a button to view more.
label: Number of child records to fetch
name: childrenRowLimit

description: Show badges for the number of records in a group and the number of child records in each parent record.
label: Show child record count
name: enableBadgeCount

description: Instead of using a view, you can select fields as columns and set their order.
label: Columns
name: columns

description: Choose how many columns to display from the view or from the columns you selected. For example, if a view has 15 columns, you can choose to show only the first 5.
label: Number of columns to display
name: columnLimit

description: Set the number of records to display in the list or on each page of the list if pagination is present.
label: Number of records per page
name: rowLimit

description: Choose the initial page to display. Pages are indexed from 0.
label: Displayed page
name: currentPage

description: Allow users to sort the list by selecting a column header or creating sorting rules with the Sort by button in the list header.
label: Allow column sorting
name: enableColumnSorting

description: Allows users to filter the list with a column filter row under the header row.
label: Allow column filtering
name: enableColumnFiltering

description: Allows users to group the list by selecting a column action from the column header or creating a grouping rule with the Group by button in the list header.
label: Allow column grouping
name: enableColumnGrouping

description: Let users open columns as data visualizations, like pie charts or bar graphs, in a side pane by selecting an action in the column header
label: Enable data visualization
name: enableDataVisualization

description: Allows users to add column calculations to specific columns in the list. This option is not available for all column types and is not supported with live lists, infinite scroll, and gallery list.
label: Allow column calculations
name: enableColumnCalculations

description: DO NOT USE, DEPRECATED. Determines which actions users can take from a column header action popover. Users can access the popover to filter the list with data in the column, group the list by column data, both, or neither.
label: Column filtering popover display DO NOT USE
name: columnFilteringPopoverDisplay

description: Allows users to filter the list by a cell with the “show matching” or “filter out” cell action.
label: Allow cell filtering
name: enableCellFiltering

description: Lets users take actions like editing and creating records directly from the list header.
label: Allow declarative actions
name: enableDeclarativeActions

description: The action configuration to use to populate the declarative actions.
label: Actions configuration for declarative actions
name: actionConfigId

label: Display all records as selected on initial load
name: allRecordsSelected

description: Sys_ids of records to display as selected.
label: Records to display as selected
name: selectedRecords

description: Sys_ids of records not to display as selected.
label: Records not to display as selected
name: exceptedRecords

description: Allows users to select the pencil row action button to edit the associated record in a panel.
label: Allow quick edit
name: enableQuickEdit

description: When true, the legacy list layout is included in the listGraphQL request.
label: Include legacy list layout
name: includeLegacyListLayout

description: Lets users move between records using up and down buttons on the quick edit panel.
label: Allow form navigation in quick edit
name: enableQuickFormNavigation

description: When Presentational List's 'Allow selection' property is set to false, you can let users navigate to the associated record by clicking a card.
label: Allow opening record by clicking the card instead of card header action
name: enableCardClickOpen

description: When Presentational List's 'Allow selection' property is set to true, and the current layout is Gallery, you can limit users to only selecting one list item rather than multiple.
label: Selection type
name: enableOnlySingleSelection

description: Dynamically select a view for the form in the quick edit panel based on Workspace View Rules. If no matching rules are found, use the view selected for the list, or the default view if none is selected.
label: Enforce view rules in quick edit
name: enforceViewRulesForQuickForm

description: Show checkboxes for selecting records only when there are declarative actions that require the selection of one or more records.
label: Only allow record selection when required by actions
name: onlyEnableSelectionWhenRequiredByActions

description: Allow users to click reference fields in the list.
label: Allow reference field links
name: enableReferenceLinks

description: To let users get live updates, the system property “glide.lists.live_list_enabled” must be on. This can slow down the list. "Only by refreshing" shows an indicator on the refresh button when updates are available. "Automatically" adds a toggle to the list header for users to turn on automatic updates. If they don't turn it on, they can still get updates by refreshing.
label: Let users get live updates
name: liveUpdates

choices.label: Only by refreshing
choices.sublabel: An indicator will appear on the refresh button when updates are available.

choices.label: Automatically
choices.sublabel: A toggle will appear for users to turn on automatic updates. If they don't turn it on, they can still get updates by refreshing.

description: Allows users to toggle live updates on and off in the list header, which can slow down the list. The system property “glide.lists.live_list_enabled” must be on.
label: Turn on live list
name: enableLiveList

description: Allows users to create My Lists under the 'My Lists' tab or as copies of Default Lists.
label: Show 'My Lists' creation
name: showListCreation

description: When enabled, lets users scroll through a list without selecting page buttons, so pagination will be hidden.
label: Turn on infinite scrolling
name: enableInfiniteScroll

description: Allow users to view related lists of records with the chevron button in each row.
label: Allow viewing related lists inline
name: enableRelatedHierarchy

description: Limits the number of records shown in a list for better performance. For example, if a list has 1 million records, you can show the first 10,000 with a count of 10,000+. If you don't set a limit or use a negative number, all records will be fetched.
label: Record count limit
name: recordCountLimit

description: Render highlighted values in the list based on a predefined configuration.
label: Fetch highlighted values
name: fetchHighlightedValues

description: The highlighted value configuration you want to use to render highlighted values.
label: Highlighted value configuration
name: highlightedValueConfigId

description: Lets users drill down into nested columns when personalizing them.
label: Allow dot walking when personalizing fields
name: enableDotWalk

description: If you would like to edit how the data is displayed, you can provide a reference to a script that will be run after the default transform script. In your custom script, you can toggle feature flags, edit column or row ordering, add custom data, and so on.
label: Transform script
name: transformScriptSysId

description: Define how your data appears on cards by selecting which fields to use as heading, body text, and more.
label: Card field mapping
name: cardFieldMapping

description: If there is a customization set defined, you can optionally provide arguments that can be accessed within the transform script.
label: Customizations to run on data fetch
name: transformScriptArgs

description: Grouping info of the specific ai group
label: AI group info
name: aiGroupInfo

description: The sys_id of the list menu content to render, which references a record in the sys_ux_list_menu_config table.
label: List menu configuration ID
name: listMenuConfigurationId

description: When the list is configured with a list menu, you can specify the initially selected list by entering the sys_id of a list record in the sys_ux_list or sys_us_my_list table.
label: Selected list ID
name: listId

description: When true, shows a section in the My lists tab that temporarily stores any lists accessed by clicking on a URL rather than being formally shared.
label: Show lists opened by link section
name: showListOpenedByLinkSection

description: When true, allows users to pin columns in the list.
label: Enable column pinning
name: enableColumnPinning

description: The parent table associated with the related list.
label: Related list parent table
name: parentTable

description: The record that this related list appears on.
label: Parent record
name: parentRecordSysId

description: Indicates whether the parent record of the related list is a new record. Provides context to the related list declarative actions
label: Is parent record a new record
name: isParentNewRecord

description: Indicates whether the parent record of the related list is read-only. Provides context to the related list declarative actions
label: Is parent record read-only
name: isParentReadOnly

description: The name of the related list.
label: Related list name
name: relatedListName

description: A generated ID that represents a shared connected list and its configuration. You do not need to set this property, it is used for compatibility with deprecated connected lists.
label: Tiny ID
name: tinyId

description: The key used for sourcing and saving a user preference about column selection and ordering if the default key can’t be determined. It should contain only lowercase letters and numbers and must be 24 to 32 characters long.
label: Column preference key
name: columnPreferenceKey

description: The decoded state persisted in the URL.
label: State persisted in the URL
name: nowUxfPersistedState

description: The unique identifying macroponent ID of the page this list appears on.
label: Page system ID
name: pageSysId

description: The unique identifying list controller ID that gets automatically generated when a list controller is added to a page in UIB.
label: List Controller ID
name: listControllerId

description: An optional list of custom action items to display under the 3-dot menu on the currently selected item in the list menu.
label: Custom menu action items
name: customMenuActionItems
